p.text: I have ___ finished the report, but I will by Friday.

fb.incorrect_default: English drops repeated words: 'She can sing and (she can) dance.' An auxiliary can stand alone — 'I have not read it, but I will' — and 'to' can end a clause: 'I did not want to, but I had to.' Leaving the words in is not wrong, only heavy.

grammar.label: ellipsis — leaving out what has already been said
grammar.form: omission after and/but/or, after auxiliaries, and after to
grammar.meaning: avoids repeating words the listener can recover

explanation.en: English drops repeated words: 'She can sing and (she can) dance.' An auxiliary can stand alone — 'I have not read it, but I will' — and 'to' can end a clause: 'I did not want to, but I had to.' Leaving the words in is not wrong, only heavy.
explanation.uz: Ingliz tili takrorlanuvchi so'zlarni tushirib qoldiradi: 'She can sing and dance.' Yordamchi fe'l yolg'iz qolishi mumkin, 'to' esa gap oxirida turishi mumkin.

grammar.positive_example: I have not finished the report, but I will by Friday.
grammar.negative_example: I have not finished the report, but I will finish the report by Friday.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida ham fe'l tushirib qoldiriladi, lekin ingliz tilida yordamchi fe'l albatta qoladi — 'I will' dan 'will' ni ham tashlab yuborish xato.

grammar.label: substitution — so, neither, nor, do so, one
grammar.form: So do I / Neither do I / Nor have they; I think so; do so; the blue one
grammar.meaning: a short word stands in for a whole phrase already used

explanation.en: 'So' replaces a positive clause ('I think so'), 'neither' and 'nor' a negative one ('Neither did she'). Both invert the subject and auxiliary. 'One' replaces a countable noun, 'do so' a whole verb phrase in formal writing.
explanation.uz: 'so' tasdiq gapni, 'neither' va 'nor' inkor gapni almashtiradi va ega bilan yordamchi fe'l o'rin almashadi. 'one' sanaladigan otni, 'do so' esa butun fe'l iborasini almashtiradi.

grammar.positive_example: She has never been to Bukhara, and neither have I.
grammar.negative_example: She has never been to Bukhara, and neither I have.

l1_notes.uz: 'So do I' tuzilmasidagi o'rin almashinuvi o'zbek tilida yo'q; qisqa javob shakllari alohida yodlanadi.
